context: Cache-aside helper: returns cached data on hit, otherwise calls fn() to compute the value and stores it. Used on hot API paths.
explanation: The error from s.client.Get is not compared against redis.Nil — any Redis error (connection timeout, serialization failure) silently falls through to the expensive fn() call, defeating the cache and hammering the backend on every Redis hiccup. Fix: check if err == redis.Nil before falling through; return other errors immediately.
